# Document attachment

Figma: standalone symbol `Document attachment`, node `58:1073` (page Components, `1:28`).
Not a variant set. Measured as an instance inside
[User chat bubble](UserMessage.md) (`2879:59434`).

A file card: a type glyph, a name and metadata, and a context menu.

## Markup

```html
<div class="v27-attachment">
  <svg class="v27-attachment__icon" viewBox="0 0 32 32" aria-hidden="true"><!-- file glyph --></svg>
  <div class="v27-attachment__body">
    <span class="v27-attachment__name">Document name</span>
    <span class="v27-attachment__meta">Document sub info</span>
  </div>
  <button type="button" class="v27-attachment__menu" aria-label="Document actions">
    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><!-- context menu --></svg>
  </button>
</div>
```

If the whole card is clickable, make the card a link and keep the menu button outside it -
a button inside a link is invalid HTML and the browser will eject the rest of the block.

| `.v27-attachment__icon` | 32px file-type glyph |

|---|---|
| padding | `--v27-spacing-sm` (12px) |
| gap | `--v27-spacing-s` (8px) |

| background | `Background/Primary` |
| glyph | `--v27-size-l` (32px) |

This is one of the five components sharing an identical card surface that V27 defines no
Card component for - FINDINGS.md #30. It is one of the two that fill with
`Background/Primary` rather than a raw white, so it **does** follow dark mode.

The file-type glyph is not bundled. Supply your own, as with every icon in this library
(FINDINGS.md #8).
